data.title: The Fed just hiked and Bitcoin is stuck at $75k. Frank Holmes says it could be at $100k by the end of 2026
data.description: Bitcoin just had its best month of 2026 in August, then ran into a hawkish Fed. Holmes says the US-Japan bailout is the tell that money printing has already started.
